Stabe

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Stabe" <gilles....@wanadoo.fr> wrote:
> Just a confirmation. As with Wolf Claws, I can play SUP Chiropteran
> Marauder after the strikes and before the Strike Resolution, correct?

As with all strike modifiers, yes:

* The damage modifier must be played before the end of the Choose
Strike phase in order to affect the current strike.
[RTR 19960112]
